# Moody Spurgeon MacPherson

[Academy](../codex/places.md#academy)

## Overview

- **Gender:** male  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P33](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0033), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>
- **Status:** alive  _(assumed)_

## Appearance

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is a funny-looking boy. He has a big, fat face, small blue eyes, and prominent ears that stick out like flaps.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson is preparing to become a minister. He experiences anxiety regarding his academic performance, specifically fearing that he will fail in English history.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)_

## Traits

- presumed failing in English history  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXI. Where the Brook and River Meet P28](../source/v01-c31.md#nw-v01-c31-p0028)</sub>

## Goals

- going to be a minister  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXX. The Queen’s Class Is Organized P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Moody Spurgeon MacPherson once fought [Charlie Sloane](../character/charlie-sloane.md) after making a comment that [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) put on airs regarding her recitations. He later attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#academy) alongside [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) and his other [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea) classmates.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXVI. The Story Club Is Formed P2](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0002), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P10](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0010), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P11](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0011), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P15](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0015), [v1 CHAPTER XXXIV. A Queen’s Girl P25](../source/v01-c34.md#nw-v01-c34-p0025)_
